links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of LLM answers to patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o FKGL 9.8; other models 13.2-14.5, all above typical patient reading level
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o achieved the highest scores in clinical accuracy (mean 3.60, SD 0.95), safety (mean 3.67, SD 1.00), and readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 9.8, compared with 13.2-14.5 for other models).

links.outcome: Medication and dietary information needs with versus without patient-specific clinical parameters
links.effect: C-RAG versus O-RAG: mean 2.93, SD 1.21 vs mean 3.86, SD 0.95 in both domains; Cohen d=-0.86, 95% CI -1.63 to -0.08; P=.02 for both.
links.quote: In Bonferroni-corrected comparisons, C-RAG had lower needs than O-RAG in both domains (observed mean 2.93, SD 1.21 vs mean 3.86, SD 0.95; Cohen d=-0.86, 95% CI -1.63 to -0.08; P=.02 for both).
